repos_data.description: Local guardrails for AI coding agents. Wraps any MCP server and blocks destructive tool calls — DROP TABLE, rm -rf, force-push, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE — before they execute. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your machine.
Your AI assistant reads CLAUDE.md and ignores it anyway. Ārai makes instruction files enforced — hooks that block, a tamper-evident audit trail, per-rule compliance stats.
